name: Father Gaimon
source:
The priest of the church, who truly believes in "saving the weak".
He lends the church to [url=https://vndb.org/c35050]Mikihisa[/url] and his hoodlums in an attempt to get them to grow a little and understand his way of thinking.
Their vigilante activities are supposed to reform them some as well, but they don't quite seem to understand that.
His physique, cultivated from his days as a police officer in the juvenile division, is proof of the depth of his character and his accepting nature.
